label: Miks
fundamentals: Riot identifies Miks as a Controller. Straight from Croatia, Miks takes the stage channeling pure sound energy. With his infectious passion and sonic powers, he rallies his squad to move as one as they set the tempo on the battlefield together.
Waveform is Miks's current Signature ability. EQUIP a Map Targeter. FIRE to set locations. ALT-FIRE to spawn Smokes at selected locations.
Bassquake is Miks's Ultimate ability. EQUIP Bassquake. FIRE to build up and unleash Sonic Radiance forward, knocking back, Deafening, and Slowing players.

patchHistory.note: Bassquake Bugfix: Fixed a bug where using it would cause the minimap cone to blink on use.

abilities.name: M-pulse
abilities.summary: EQUIP M-pulse. ALT-FIRE to toggle between Concuss and Healing outputs. FIRE to throw the device. Upon landing, M-pulse sends out sound waves, either Concussing or Healing players.

stats.Source: Riot game text + Valorant Wiki current infobox

abilities.purpose: M-pulse preserves team resources. Use its verified recovery effect only when the restored player can safely return to a useful fight.
abilities.setup: M-pulse must be equipped before use. Prepare it behind cover, then return to the weapon as soon as the stated effect is active.
